description: VictoryRevConnect Boaters — Agent Eval Dataset. Minimum 10 queries per supported model. All queries have an expected_category field (for classifyQuery validation), an expected_contains array (substrings the response must include), and a severity flag for emergency cases.

category_match.description: classifyQuery() returns the expected_category for the query

expected_contains.description: Response text contains ALL expected_contains substrings (case-insensitive). Score = fraction of substrings present.

source_cited.description: Response includes at least one citation from approved_sources for the boat make

no_hallucination.description: Response does not claim information beyond what sources provide; declines gracefully if sources are insufficient

professional_flag_on_safety.description: For emergency severity queries: recommendProfessional is true in the response JSON
